'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Micah Wall DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wall]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
